notes.title: Trading Cards!
notes.content:
A special set of Trading Cards has been added to Mutant Mudds Deluxe!

There are eight awesome Trading Cards in total, which contribute to six wonderful Badges through crafting complete Trading Card sets!
[list]
[*]Max Boost
[*]Skeyes
[*]Royal Mudd
[*]Slammer Hammer
[*]Pork Plop
[*]Grannie
[*]Devil Cat Ball
[*]Ditsy Drop
[/list]
And, don't forget: there are also five Emoticons and three Background images to be had!

Happy hunting / trading!

notes.title: Joypad Support
notes.content:
Yes, this game does support joypads. Hooray for buttons! You may need to access "Control Configuration" to set yours up. Here's how:

[list]
In Window View (press Alt+Enter if in Fullscreen View) go to the 'Options' pull-down menu.
Select 'Control Configuration'.
[/list]

The 'Control Configuration' panel provides many control options for you to choose or adjust.

Hope this helps. Happy blasting!
